metadata.description: DSH client plugin: render the built-in session cache-hit percentage with three decimal places.
metadata.name: dsh-cache-precision

paragraphs.text: DSH client plugin: render the built-in session cache-hit percentage with three decimal places.

1. Rewrites the built-in cache-hit percentage with **three decimals**
(`缓存命中 12%` -> `缓存命中 12.345%`)

.
2. Widens the built-in stats line (`max-width` grows beyond the chat content
width) so the extra p

recision and other dock items no longer truncate with
`...`.

Both read the same `tokenUsage` projection and re-apply automatically after
React re-renders.
